The record registry

Source: R/registry.R
read_records.Rd

records.csv holds one row per unique record (search hit); see SPEC.md section 6.

Usage

read_records(path = ".")

add_records(path = ".", records, search = "manual")

link_record(path = ".", record_id, study_id)

Arguments

path

Project root.

records

Data frame with at least title, and ideally doi, pmid, year, journal, authors (a character string, ; -separated).

search

Search id the records came from (see add_search()), or "manual".

record_id

Record id(s).

study_id

Study id to link the record(s) to.

Value

read_records(): a tibble with the registry columns.

add_records(): a tibble with record_id and new (whether the record was not in the registry before), invisibly. Records already present get the search id added to their searches.
